description: Land Title Settlement Department - Katiyawa, Weligama D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820068
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding ownership of specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, owner names, extent, and title details) under the Registration of Title Act. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registrations, property ownership, and land title determinations.
